dishes.name: Brisket Sandwich
dishes.description: Braised certified Angus beef brisket on toasted Challah bread, with sliced red onions and dill labane sauce. Served with choice of House Made Potato Salad or French Fries with Ketchup. $25 per person.

moods.evidence: Braised certified Angus beef brisket on toasted Challah bread

blurb: A single-course $25 brisket sandwich special with potato salad or fries, offered October 16-25.
